import math
import config_io = "./config_io.qui"

class Transaction(int number, int start, int core, string kind, int block)
    string[] snoops := []
    snoop_hits := 0
    invalidations := 0
    supplier := -1
    flushed := false
    l2 := ""
    evicted := -1
    string[] back_copies := []
    dirty_eviction := false
    source := ""
class Bus(int latency)
    free := 0
    wait := 0
    Transaction[] transactions := []

Transaction assign(Bus &bus, int core, string kind, int block, int requested)
    start := math.max(requested, bus.free)
    bus.wait += start - requested
    bus.free = start + bus.latency
    result := Transaction(int(#bus.transactions) + 1, start, core, kind, block)
    bus.transactions = bus.transactions.append(result)
    return result

string format_line(Transaction transaction, int line_size)
    result := "{transaction.number} {transaction.start} c{transaction.core} {transaction.kind} " + config_io.hex_address(transaction.block * line_size)
    if transaction.kind == "WB"
        return result
    result += " snoop " + (if #transaction.snoops == 0 then "none" else transaction.snoops.join(" "))
    if transaction.kind == "BusUpgr"
        return result
    if transaction.kind == "BusRd" or transaction.kind == "BusRdX"
        result += " data " + transaction.source
    result += " l2 " + transaction.l2
    if transaction.evicted >= 0
        copies := if #transaction.back_copies == 0 then "none" else transaction.back_copies.join(" ")
        quality := if transaction.dirty_eviction then "dirty" else "clean"
        result += " evict " + config_io.hex_address(transaction.evicted * line_size) + " {copies} {quality}"
    return result

class Line(block := -1, state := "I")
class Cache(int sets, int ways, string replacement)
    Line[][] entries := [for i := (0:<sets)[] then [for j := (0:<ways)[] then Line()]]
    int[][] touched := [for i := (0:<sets)[] then array(nat(ways), fill = 0)]
    int[][] bits := [for i := (0:<sets)[] then array(nat(ways), fill = 0)]
    fills := array(nat(sets), fill = 0)
    evictions := array(nat(sets), fill = 0)
    clock := 0

int locate(Cache cache, int block)
    row := block % cache.sets
    for: way < cache.ways
        if cache.entries[row][way].block == block
            return way
    return -1

string state(Cache cache, int block)
    way := locate(cache, block)
    return if way < 0 then "I" else cache.entries[block % cache.sets][way].state

void change(Cache &cache, int block, string target_state)
    way := locate(cache, block)
    if way >= 0
        cache.entries[block % cache.sets][way].state = target_state

void touch_way(Cache &cache, int row, int way, bool fill)
    if cache.replacement == "LRU" or (cache.replacement == "FIFO" and fill)
        cache.clock += 1
        cache.touched[row][way] = cache.clock
    elif cache.replacement == "PLRU"
        low := 0
        high := cache.ways
        node := 1
        while high - low > 1
            middle := (low + high) / 2
            if way < middle
                cache.bits[row][node] = 1
                high = middle
                node *= 2
            else
                cache.bits[row][node] = 0
                low = middle
                node = 2 * node + 1

void touch(Cache &cache, int block)
    way := locate(cache, block)
    if way >= 0
        touch_way(&cache, block % cache.sets, way, false)

int victim(Cache cache, int row)
    if cache.replacement == "PLRU"
        low := 0
        high := cache.ways
        node := 1
        while high - low > 1
            middle := (low + high) / 2
            if cache.bits[row][node] == 0
                high = middle
                node *= 2
            else
                low = middle
                node = node * 2 + 1
        return low
    result := 0
    for: 1 <= way < cache.ways
        if cache.touched[row][way] < cache.touched[row][result]
            result = way
    return result

Line fill(Cache &cache, int block, string target_state)
    row := block % cache.sets
    way := -1
    for: candidate < cache.ways
        if cache.entries[row][candidate].block < 0
            way = candidate
            break
    if way < 0
        way = victim(cache, row)
    old := cache.entries[row][way]
    if old.block >= 0
        cache.evictions[row] += 1
    cache.entries[row][way] = Line(block, target_state)
    cache.fills[row] += 1
    touch_way(&cache, row, way, true)
    return old

Line remove(Cache &cache, int block)
    way := locate(cache, block)
    if way < 0
        return Line()
    row := block % cache.sets
    old := cache.entries[row][way]
    cache.entries[row][way] = Line()
    return old

string order(Cache cache, int row)
    if cache.replacement == "PLRU"
        return if cache.ways == 1 then "-" else [for i := (1:<(cache.ways))[] then "{cache.bits[row][i]}"].join("")
    active := [for way := (0:<(cache.ways))[] if cache.entries[row][way].block >= 0 then way]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#active)
        way := active[i]
        j := i
        while j > 0 and cache.touched[row][active[j - 1]] < cache.touched[row][way]
            active[j] = active[j - 1]
            j -= 1
        active[j] = way
    return if #active == 0 then "-" else [for way := active[] then "{way}"].join(" ")

class Scenario(string name, string protocol, string l1, string l2)
class Region(string name, int first, int last)
class Config()
    cores := 0
    line_size := 0
    l1_size := 0
    l1_ways := 0
    l2_size := 0
    l2_ways := 0
    t1 := 0
    t2 := 0
    tm := 0
    tb := 0
    interval := 0
    top := 0
    primary := ""
    Scenario[] scenarios := []
    Region[] regions := []
    int[] watch := []

bool decimal_integer(string text, maximum := 9)
    if #text == 0 or int(#text) > maximum or (#text > 1 and text[0] == "0")
        return false
    for: i < int(#text)
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

int hex_digit(string character)
    digits := "0123456789abcdef"
    for: i < 16
        if digits[i] == character
            return i
    return -1

bool valid_hex(string text)
    if #text != 8
        return false
    for: i < 8
        if hex_digit(text[i]) < 0
            return false
    return true

int parse_hex(string text)
    result := 0
    for: i < int(#text)
        result = 16 * result + hex_digit(text[i])
    return result

string hex_address(int value)
    low := nat(value % 4294967296)
    hex := low.b16
    return "0" * (8 - #hex) + hex

string[] read_lines(string path)
    source := file.read(path)
    string[] result := []
    while .source(string &line)
        result = result.append(line)
    return result

Config read_config()
    config := Config()
    for line := read_lines("input/config.txt")[]
        f := line.split(" ")
        if f[0] == "CORES"
            config.cores = int(f[1])
        elif f[0] == "LINE"
            config.line_size = int(f[1])
        elif f[0] == "L1"
            config.l1_size = int(f[1])
            config.l1_ways = int(f[2])
        elif f[0] == "L2"
            config.l2_size = int(f[1])
            config.l2_ways = int(f[2])
        elif f[0] == "LATENCY"
            config.t1 = int(f[1])
            config.t2 = int(f[2])
            config.tm = int(f[3])
            config.tb = int(f[4])
        elif f[0] == "SCENARIO"
            config.scenarios = config.scenarios.append(Scenario(f[1], f[2], f[3], f[4]))
        elif f[0] == "PRIMARY"
            config.primary = f[1]
        elif f[0] == "INTERVAL"
            config.interval = int(f[1])
        elif f[0] == "TOP"
            config.top = int(f[1])
        elif f[0] == "REGION"
            config.regions = config.regions.append(Region(f[1], parse_hex(f[2]), parse_hex(f[3])))
        else
            config.watch = config.watch.append(parse_hex(f[1]) / config.line_size)
    return config

void write_lines(string filename, string[] lines)
    destination := file.write("output/" + filename)
    if #lines > 0
        .destination(lines.join(NL) + NL)

import math
import config_io = "./config_io.qui"
import cache = "./cache.qui"
import protocol = "./protocol.qui"
import bus = "./bus.qui"
import stats = "./stats.qui"

class Event(int number, int cycle, int core, string operation, int address, int block, int word)
    distance := 0
class Trace(Event[] events, string[] rejected, int line_count)
class Reuse(int accesses, int lines, int cold, int[] distances, int[] capacities, int[] lru, int opt)
class Access(Event event, int issue, int latency, string service, bool hit, string miss)
class WordHistory(int writer, bool[] readers)
class Sharing(int block, local int cores, local int words)
    readers := array(nat(cores), fill = false)
    writers := array(nat(cores), fill = false)
    bool[][] word_readers := [for i := (0:<words)[] then array(nat(cores), fill = false)]
    bool[][] word_writers := [for i := (0:<words)[] then array(nat(cores), fill = false)]
    reads := 0
    writes := 0
class Simulation(config_io.Config config, config_io.Scenario scenario, Event[] events)
    cache.Cache[] l1 := [for i := (0:<(config.cores))[] then cache.Cache(config.l1_size / (config.line_size * config.l1_ways), config.l1_ways, scenario.l1)]
    l2 := cache.Cache(config.l2_size / (config.line_size * config.l2_ways), config.l2_ways, scenario.l2)
    shared_bus := bus.Bus(config.tb)
    stats.Counters[] cores := [for i := (0:<(config.cores))[] then stats.Counters()]
    l2_counts := stats.Counters()
    int[][] ordered := [for i := (0:<(config.cores))[] then [for j := (0:<(int(#events)))[] if events[j].core == i then j]]
    indices := array(nat(config.cores), fill = 0)
    ready := array(nat(config.cores), fill = 0)
    write_completion := array(nat(config.cores), fill = 0)
    distinct<int>[] seen := [for i := (0:<(config.cores))[] then distinct<int>()]
    invalidations := map<(int, int), bool[]>()
    Access[] accesses := []
    string[] watch_lines := []
    last_writer := map<int, int>()
    handoffs := map<int, int>()
    word_history := map<(int, int), WordHistory>()
    int[][] communication := [for i := (0:<(config.cores))[] then array(nat(config.cores), fill = 0)]
    sharing_misses := map<int, int[]>()

int integer_value(map<int, int> values, int key, fallback := 0)
    match values.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return fallback

int flag_count(bool[] flags)
    result := 0
    for flag := flags[]
        if flag
            result += 1
    return result

Trace validate(config_io.Config config)
    lines := config_io.read_lines("input/trace.txt")
    Event[] events := []
    string[] rejected := []
    latest := 0
    for: index < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[index].split(" ")
        reason := ""
        empty := false
        for field := fields[]
            if field == ""
                empty = true
        if (#fields != 3 and #fields != 4) or empty
            reason = "fields"
        elif not config_io.decimal_integer(fields[0], 7)
            reason = "cycle"
        elif not config_io.decimal_integer(fields[1]) or int(fields[1]) >= config.cores
            reason = "core"
        elif (fields[2] != "R" and fields[2] != "W" and fields[2] != "FENCE") or (fields[2] == "FENCE" and #fields != 3) or (fields[2] != "FENCE" and #fields != 4)
            reason = "op"
        elif fields[2] != "FENCE" and (not config_io.valid_hex(fields[3]) or config_io.parse_hex(fields[3]) % 4 != 0 or config_io.parse_hex(fields[3]) > 2147483647)
            reason = "address"
        elif int(fields[0]) < latest
            reason = "order"
        if reason != ""
            rejected = rejected.append("reject line {index + 1} {reason}")
            continue
        latest = int(fields[0])
        address := if fields[2] == "FENCE" then 0 else config_io.parse_hex(fields[3])
        events = events.append(Event(int(#events) + 1, latest, int(fields[1]), fields[2], address, address / config.line_size, address % config.line_size / 4))
    return Trace(events, rejected, int(#lines))

int low_bit(int value)
    result := 1
    rest := value
    while rest % 2 == 0
        result *= 2
        rest /= 2
    return result

int prefix(int[] tree, int position)
    result := 0
    index := position
    while index > 0
        result += tree[index]
        index -= low_bit(index)
    return result

void update_tree(int[] &tree, int position, int amount)
    index := position
    while index < int(#tree)
        tree[index] += amount
        index += low_bit(index)

Reuse[] reuse_analysis(Event[] &events, config_io.Config config)
    cap := config.l1_size / config.line_size
    capacities := [cap / 4, cap / 2, cap, 2 * cap, 4 * cap]
    Reuse[] result := []
    for: core < config.cores
        ordered := [for i := (0:<(int(#events)))[] if events[i].core == core and events[i].operation != "FENCE" then i]
        count := int(#ordered)
        tree := array(nat(count + 1), fill = 0)
        map<int, int> previous
        distances := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        misses := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        cold := 0
        for: i < count
            event_index := ordered[i]
            block := events[event_index].block
            last := integer_value(previous, block)
            distance := 0
            if last == 0
                cold += 1
            else
                distance = prefix(tree, count) - prefix(tree, last) + 1
                update_tree(&tree, last, -1)
                bucket := if distance == 1 then 0 elif distance <= 4 then 1 elif distance <= 16 then 2 elif distance <= 64 then 3 elif distance <= 256 then 4 else 5
                distances[bucket] += 1
            update_tree(&tree, i + 1, 1)
            .previous.set(block, i + 1)
            events[event_index].distance = distance
            for: k < 5
                if distance == 0 or distance > capacities[k]
                    misses[k] += 1
        next := array(nat(count), fill = count + 1)
        map<int, int> upcoming
        cursor := count - 1
        while cursor >= 0
            block := events[ordered[cursor]].block
            next[cursor] = integer_value(upcoming, block, count + 1)
            .upcoming.set(block, cursor)
            cursor -= 1
        map<int, int> resident
        opt := 0
        for: i < count
            block := events[ordered[i]].block
            if not resident.has(block)
                opt += 1
                if int(resident.size()) == cap
                    victim := -1
                    furthest := -1
                    for candidate := resident.keys()[]
                        future := integer_value(resident, candidate)
                        if future > furthest or (future == furthest and candidate < victim)
                            victim = candidate
                            furthest = future
                    .resident.remove(victim)
            .resident.set(block, next[i])
        result = result.append(Reuse(count, int(previous.size()), cold, distances, capacities, misses, opt))
    return result

string[] line_states(Simulation sim, int block)
    return [for l1 := sim.l1[] then cache.state(l1, block)].append(cache.state(sim.l2, block))

void communicate(Simulation &sim, Event event)
    (int, int) key := (event.block, event.word)
    history := WordHistory(-1, array(nat(sim.config.cores), fill = false))
    match sim.word_history.get(key)
        WordHistory value
            history = value
        none
            history.writer = -1
    if event.operation == "W"
        former := integer_value(sim.last_writer, event.block, -1)
        if former >= 0 and former != event.core
            .sim.handoffs.set(event.block, integer_value(sim.handoffs, event.block) + 1)
        .sim.last_writer.set(event.block, event.core)
        history = WordHistory(event.core, array(nat(sim.config.cores), fill = false))
    elif history.writer >= 0 and history.writer != event.core and not history.readers[event.core]
        sim.communication[history.writer][event.core] += 1
        history.readers[event.core] = true
    .sim.word_history.set(key, history)

bus.Transaction issue_transaction(Simulation &sim, int core, string kind, int block, int requested)
    transaction := bus.assign(&sim.shared_bus, core, kind, block, requested)
    stats.add(&sim.cores[core], kind)
    if kind == "WB"
        stats.add(&sim.l2_counts, "writebacks")
    return transaction

void snoop_others(Simulation &sim, bus.Transaction &transaction, int word)
    block := transaction.block
    requester := transaction.core
    for: core < sim.config.cores
        if core == requester
            continue
        old := cache.state(sim.l1[core], block)
        if old == "I"
            continue
        transition := protocol.snoop(sim.scenario.protocol, old, transaction.kind)
        transaction.snoops = transaction.snoops.append("c{core}:{old}>{transition.state}")
        transaction.snoop_hits += 1
        if transition.state == "I"
            removed := cache.remove(&sim.l1[core], block)
            transaction.invalidations += 1
            stats.add(&sim.cores[requester], "invalidations_sent")
            stats.add(&sim.cores[core], "invalidations_received")
            words := array(nat(sim.config.line_size / 4), fill = false)
            words[word] = true
            .sim.invalidations.set((core, block), words)
        else
            cache.change(&sim.l1[core], block, transition.state)
        if transition.supply
            transaction.supplier = core
            stats.add(&sim.cores[core], "supplied")
        if transition.flush_requested
            transaction.flushed = true
    if transaction.flushed
        stats.add(&sim.l2_counts, "flushes")

void access_l2(Simulation &sim, bus.Transaction &transaction)
    block := transaction.block
    stats.add(&sim.l2_counts, "lookups")
    if cache.state(sim.l2, block) != "I"
        transaction.l2 = "hit"
        stats.add(&sim.l2_counts, "hits")
        cache.touch(&sim.l2, block)
    else
        transaction.l2 = "miss"
        stats.add(&sim.l2_counts, "misses")
        evicted := cache.fill(&sim.l2, block, "C")
        if evicted.block >= 0
            transaction.evicted = evicted.block
            transaction.dirty_eviction = evicted.state == "D"
            stats.add(&sim.l2_counts, "evictions")
            for: core < sim.config.cores
                old := cache.state(sim.l1[core], evicted.block)
                if old == "I"
                    continue
                removed := cache.remove(&sim.l1[core], evicted.block)
                transaction.back_copies = transaction.back_copies.append("c{core}:{old}")
                stats.add(&sim.cores[core], "back_invalidations")
                if protocol.dirty(old)
                    transaction.dirty_eviction = true
            if transaction.dirty_eviction
                stats.add(&sim.l2_counts, "dirty_evictions")
    if transaction.flushed or transaction.kind == "BusWr"
        cache.change(&sim.l2, block, "D")

class Completion(int tick, string service)

Completion run_transaction(Simulation &sim, Event event, string kind, int requested)
    transaction := issue_transaction(&sim, event.core, kind, event.block, requested)
    snoop_others(&sim, &transaction, event.word)
    if kind != "BusUpgr"
        access_l2(&sim, &transaction)
    completion := transaction.start + sim.config.tb
    service := "upgrade"
    if kind == "BusWr"
        completion += sim.config.t2 + (if transaction.l2 == "miss" then sim.config.tm else 0)
        service = "through"
    elif kind != "BusUpgr"
        if transaction.supplier >= 0
            transaction.source = "c{transaction.supplier}"
            service = "cache"
        elif transaction.l2 == "hit"
            completion += sim.config.t2
            transaction.source = "L2"
            service = "l2"
        else
            completion += sim.config.t2 + sim.config.tm
            transaction.source = "mem"
            service = "memory"
    sim.shared_bus.transactions[transaction.number - 1] = transaction
    return Completion(completion, service)

void handle_access(Simulation &sim, Event event, int issue)
    core := event.core
    block := event.block
    before := [for watched := sim.config.watch[] then line_states(sim, watched)]
    old := cache.state(sim.l1[core], block)
    hit := old != "I"
    stats.add(&sim.cores[core], "accesses")
    stats.add(&sim.cores[core], if event.operation == "R" then "reads" else "writes")
    stats.add(&sim.cores[core], if hit then "hits" else "misses")
    others := false
    for: k < sim.config.cores
        if k != core and cache.state(sim.l1[k], block) != "I"
            others = true
    transition := protocol.requester(sim.scenario.protocol, old, event.operation, others)
    miss := ""
    sharing := ""
    if hit
        cache.touch(&sim.l1[core], block)
    else
        if not sim.seen[core].has(block)
            miss = "compulsory"
        elif sim.invalidations.has((core, block))
            miss = "coherence"
            match sim.invalidations.get((core, block))
                bool[] words
                    sharing = if words[event.word] then "true_sharing" else "false_sharing"
                none
                    sharing = ""
        elif event.distance > sim.config.l1_size / sim.config.line_size
            miss = "capacity"
        else
            miss = "conflict"
        stats.add(&sim.cores[core], miss)
        if sharing != ""
            stats.add(&sim.cores[core], sharing)
            counts := [0, 0]
            match sim.sharing_misses.get(block)
                int[] existing
                    counts = existing
                none
                    counts = [0, 0]
            counts[if sharing == "true_sharing" then 0 else 1] += 1
            .sim.sharing_misses.set(block, counts)
    .sim.seen[core].add(block)
    if event.operation == "W"
        for: k < sim.config.cores
            if k == core
                continue
            match sim.invalidations.get((k, block))
                bool[] words
                    words[event.word] = true
                    .sim.invalidations.set((k, block), words)
                none
                    continue
    communicate(&sim, event)
    completion := Completion(issue + sim.config.t1, "l1")
    if transition.transaction != ""
        completion = run_transaction(&sim, event, transition.transaction, issue + sim.config.t1)
    if old != "I"
        cache.change(&sim.l1[core], block, transition.state)
    elif transition.state != "I"
        evicted := cache.fill(&sim.l1[core], block, transition.state)
        .sim.invalidations.remove((core, block))
        if protocol.dirty(evicted.state)
            transaction := issue_transaction(&sim, core, "WB", evicted.block, sim.shared_bus.free)
            cache.touch(&sim.l2, evicted.block)
            cache.change(&sim.l2, evicted.block, "D")
    latency := completion.tick - issue
    stats.add(&sim.cores[core], "latency", latency)
    stats.add(&sim.cores[core], if event.operation == "R" then "read_latency" else "write_latency", latency)
    stats.add(&sim.cores[core], completion.service)
    sim.cores[core].finish = math.max(sim.cores[core].finish, completion.tick)
    if event.operation == "R"
        sim.ready[core] = completion.tick
    else
        sim.ready[core] = issue + sim.config.t1
        sim.write_completion[core] = math.max(sim.write_completion[core], completion.tick)
    sim.accesses = sim.accesses.append(Access(event, issue, latency, completion.service, hit, miss))
    for: i < int(#sim.config.watch)
        watched := sim.config.watch[i]
        after := line_states(sim, watched)
        if watched != block and before[i] == after
            continue
        columns := [for k := (0:<(sim.config.cores))[] then "c{k}:{after[k]}"].join(" ")
        sim.watch_lines = sim.watch_lines.append("{event.number} {issue} c{core} {event.operation} " + config_io.hex_address(event.address) + " line " + config_io.hex_address(watched * sim.config.line_size) + " {columns} L2:{after[sim.config.cores]}")

void simulate(Simulation &sim)
    while true
        chosen := -1
        issue := 0
        for: core < sim.config.cores
            if sim.indices[core] >= int(#sim.ordered[core])
                continue
            event := sim.events[sim.ordered[core][sim.indices[core]]]
            int candidate := math.max(event.cycle, sim.ready[core])
            if chosen < 0 or candidate < issue
                chosen = core
                issue = candidate
        if chosen < 0
            break
        event := sim.events[sim.ordered[chosen][sim.indices[chosen]]]
        sim.indices[chosen] += 1
        if event.operation == "FENCE"
            int completion := math.max(issue, sim.write_completion[chosen])
            stats.add(&sim.cores[chosen], "fences")
            stats.add(&sim.cores[chosen], "fence_stall", completion - issue)
            sim.ready[chosen] = completion
            sim.cores[chosen].finish = math.max(sim.cores[chosen].finish, completion)
        else
            handle_access(&sim, event, issue)

string[] reuse_lines(Reuse[] analyses)
    string[] lines := []
    labels := ["1", "2-4", "5-16", "17-64", "65-256", "257+"]
    for: core < int(#analyses)
        analysis := analyses[core]
        distances := [for i := (int(0):<6)[] then "{labels[i]}:{analysis.distances[i]}"].join(" ")
        misses := [for i := (int(0):<5)[] then "{analysis.capacities[i]}:{analysis.lru[i]}"].join(" ")
        lines = lines.append("reuse c{core} accesses {analysis.accesses} lines {analysis.lines} distance {distances} cold {analysis.cold}")
        lines = lines.append("mrc c{core} lru {misses} opt {analysis.capacities[2]}:{analysis.opt}")
    return lines

string[] scenario_lines(Simulation sim)
    c := sim.config
    total := stats.total(sim.cores)
    lines := ["scenario {sim.scenario.name} {sim.scenario.protocol} {sim.scenario.l1} {sim.scenario.l2}"]
    for: core < c.cores
        lines = lines.concat(stats.six_lines("c{core}", sim.cores[core]))
    lines = lines.concat(stats.six_lines("total", total))
    transactions := int(#sim.shared_bus.transactions)
    lines = lines.append("l2 " + stats.values(sim.l2_counts, ["lookups", "hits", "misses", "flushes", "writebacks", "evictions", "dirty_evictions"]))
    lines = lines.append("bus transactions {transactions} busy {c.tb * transactions} wait {sim.shared_bus.wait} utilization " + stats.decimal(100 * c.tb * transactions, total.finish))
    data := c.line_size * (stats.get(total, "BusRd") + stats.get(total, "BusRdX") + stats.get(total, "WB")) + 4 * stats.get(total, "BusWr")
    memory := c.line_size * (stats.get(sim.l2_counts, "misses") + stats.get(sim.l2_counts, "dirty_evictions"))
    lines = lines.append("traffic command_bytes {8 * transactions} data_bytes {data} memory_bytes {memory}")
    probes := 0
    snoop_hits := 0
    fanout := array(nat(c.cores), fill = 0)
    for transaction := sim.shared_bus.transactions[]
        if transaction.kind != "WB"
            probes += c.cores - 1
            snoop_hits += transaction.snoop_hits
        if transaction.kind == "BusRdX" or transaction.kind == "BusUpgr" or transaction.kind == "BusWr"
            fanout[transaction.invalidations] += 1
    lines = lines.append("snoops probes {probes} hits {snoop_hits} fanout " + [for i := (0:<(c.cores))[] then "{i}:{fanout[i]}"].join(" "))
    histogram := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    for access := sim.accesses[]
        value := access.latency
        bucket := if value == 1 then 0 elif value <= 9 then 1 elif value <= 29 then 2 elif value <= 99 then 3 elif value <= 299 then 4 else 5
        histogram[bucket] += 1
    ranges := ["1", "2-9", "10-29", "30-99", "100-299", "300+"]
    distribution := [for i := (int(0):<6)[] then "{ranges[i]}:{histogram[i]}"].join(" ")
    reads := stats.get(total, "read_latency")
    writes := stats.get(total, "write_latency")
    lines = lines.append("latencies reads {reads} writes {writes} histogram {distribution}")
    return lines

class Hot(int block, stats.Counters counters, bool[] cores)

string[] hot_lines(Simulation sim)
    map<int, int> slots
    Hot[] hot := []
    for transaction := sim.shared_bus.transactions[]
        int block := transaction.block
        slot := integer_value(slots, block, -1)
        if slot < 0
            slot = int(#hot)
            .slots.set(block, slot)
            hot = hot.append(Hot(block, stats.Counters(), array(nat(sim.config.cores), fill = false)))
        stats.add(&hot[slot].counters, "transactions")
        stats.add(&hot[slot].counters, transaction.kind)
        stats.add(&hot[slot].counters, "invalidations", transaction.invalidations)
        hot[slot].cores[transaction.core] = true
    for access := sim.accesses[]
        slot := integer_value(slots, access.event.block, -1)
        if slot >= 0 and not access.hit
            stats.add(&hot[slot].counters, "misses")
            if access.miss == "coherence"
                stats.add(&hot[slot].counters, "coherence")
    order := [for i := (0:<(int(#hot)))[] then i]
    counts := [for item := hot[] then -stats.get(item.counters, "transactions")]
    blocks := [for item := hot[] then item.block]
    order = order.sorted(by = (counts, blocks))
    lines := ["hot {sim.scenario.name}"]
    for: rank < math.min(sim.config.top, int(#order))
        item := hot[order[rank]]
        lines = lines.append("{rank + 1} " + config_io.hex_address(item.block * sim.config.line_size) + " " + stats.values(item.counters, ["transactions", "BusRd", "BusRdX", "BusUpgr", "BusWr", "WB", "misses", "coherence", "invalidations"]) + " cores " + stats.core_string(item.cores))
    return lines

string[] interval_lines(Simulation sim)
    width := sim.config.interval
    count := stats.total(sim.cores).finish / width + 1
    accesses := [for i := (0:<count)[] then array(nat(sim.config.cores), fill = 0)]
    misses := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    transactions := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    busy := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for access := sim.accesses[]
        interval := access.issue / width
        accesses[interval][access.event.core] += 1
        if not access.hit
            misses[interval] += 1
    for transaction := sim.shared_bus.transactions[]
        if transaction.start / width < count
            transactions[transaction.start / width] += 1
        int first := transaction.start / width
        int last := math.min(count - 1, (transaction.start + sim.config.tb - 1) / width)
        for: first <= interval <= last
            busy[interval] += math.max(0, math.min(transaction.start + sim.config.tb, (interval + 1) * width) - math.max(transaction.start, interval * width))
    lines := ["intervals {sim.scenario.name} {width}"]
    for: interval < count
        values := [for value := accesses[interval][] then "{value}"].join(" ")
        lines = lines.append("{interval} {interval * width}-{(interval + 1) * width - 1} accesses {values} misses {misses[interval]} transactions {transactions[interval]} busy {busy[interval]} utilization " + stats.decimal(100 * busy[interval], width))
    return lines

string[] slow_lines(Simulation sim)
    order := [for i := (0:<(int(#sim.accesses)))[] then i]
    latencies := [for access := sim.accesses[] then -access.latency]
    numbers := [for access := sim.accesses[] then access.event.number]
    order = order.sorted(by = (latencies, numbers))
    lines := ["slowest {sim.scenario.name}"]
    for: rank < math.min(sim.config.top, int(#order))
        access := sim.accesses[order[rank]]
        event := access.event
        lines = lines.append("{rank + 1} event {event.number} cycle {access.issue} c{event.core} {event.operation} " + config_io.hex_address(event.address) + " latency {access.latency} service {access.service}")
    return lines

int region_index(config_io.Config config, int address)
    for: i < int(#config.regions)
        config_io.Region region := config.regions[i]
        if region.first <= address and address <= region.last
            return i
    return int(#config.regions)

string[] region_lines(Simulation sim)
    count := int(#sim.config.regions) + 1
    regions := [for i := (0:<count)[] then stats.Counters()]
    for access := sim.accesses[]
        index := region_index(sim.config, access.event.address)
        stats.add(&regions[index], "accesses")
        stats.add(&regions[index], if access.event.operation == "R" then "reads" else "writes")
        stats.add(&regions[index], if access.hit then "hits" else access.miss)
        stats.add(&regions[index], "latency", access.latency)
    for transaction := sim.shared_bus.transactions[]
        index := region_index(sim.config, transaction.block * sim.config.line_size)
        stats.add(&regions[index], "transactions")
    lines := ["regions {sim.scenario.name}"]
    for: i < count
        string name := if i == count - 1 then "other" else sim.config.regions[i].name
        accesses := stats.get(regions[i], "accesses")
        latency := stats.get(regions[i], "latency")
        amat := if accesses == 0 then "-" else stats.fraction(latency, accesses) + " " + stats.decimal(latency, accesses)
        lines = lines.append(name + " " + stats.values(regions[i], ["accesses", "reads", "writes", "hits", "compulsory", "capacity", "conflict", "coherence", "transactions", "latency"]) + " amat " + amat)
    return lines

string[] sharing_lines(Simulation sim)
    map<int, int> slots
    Sharing[] records := []
    for event := sim.events[]
        if event.operation == "FENCE"
            continue
        index := integer_value(slots, event.block, -1)
        if index < 0
            index = int(#records)
            .slots.set(event.block, index)
            records = records.append(Sharing(event.block, sim.config.cores, sim.config.line_size / 4))
        &record := &records[index]
        if event.operation == "R"
            record.reads += 1
            record.readers[event.core] = true
            record.word_readers[event.word][event.core] = true
        else
            record.writes += 1
            record.writers[event.core] = true
            record.word_writers[event.word][event.core] = true
    string[] lines := []
    shared_count := 0
    true_count := 0
    false_count := 0
    true_misses := 0
    false_misses := 0
    for block := slots.keys().sorted()[]
        record := records[integer_value(slots, block)]
        cores := [for i := (0:<(sim.config.cores))[] then record.readers[i] or record.writers[i]]
        if flag_count(cores) < 2 or flag_count(record.writers) == 0
            continue
        true_line := false
        string[] words := []
        for: word < sim.config.line_size / 4
            readers := record.word_readers[word]
            writers := record.word_writers[word]
            both := [for i := (0:<(sim.config.cores))[] then readers[i] or writers[i]]
            if flag_count(both) == 0
                continue
            words = words.append("w{word}=" + stats.core_string(readers) + "/" + stats.core_string(writers))
            if flag_count(writers) > 0 and flag_count(both) >= 2
                true_line = true
        misses := [0, 0]
        match sim.sharing_misses.get(block)
            int[] value
                misses = value
            none
                misses = [0, 0]
        shared_count += 1
        if true_line
            true_count += 1
        else
            false_count += 1
        true_misses += misses[0]
        false_misses += misses[1]
        kind := if true_line then "true" else "false"
        lines = lines.append(config_io.hex_address(block * sim.config.line_size) + " {kind} cores " + stats.core_string(cores) + " writers " + stats.core_string(record.writers) + " reads {record.reads} writes {record.writes} handoffs {integer_value(sim.handoffs, block)} coherence {misses[0] + misses[1]} true {misses[0]} false {misses[1]} words " + words.join(" "))
    lines = lines.append("lines {shared_count} true_lines {true_count} false_lines {false_count} coherence {true_misses + false_misses} true {true_misses} false {false_misses}")
    lines = lines.append("communication")
    for: core < sim.config.cores
        lines = lines.append("c{core} " + [for value := sim.communication[core][] then "{value}"].join(" "))
    return lines

string[] cache_rows(string label, cache.Cache store, int line_size)
    string[] lines := []
    for: row < store.sets
        string[] ways := []
        for line := store.entries[row][]
            ways = ways.append(if line.block < 0 then "-" else config_io.hex_address(line.block * line_size) + ":" + line.state)
        lines = lines.append("{label} {row} " + ways.join(" ") + " " + store.replacement.lower_ascii() + " " + cache.order(store, row) + " fills {store.fills[row]} evictions {store.evictions[row]}")
    return lines

string[] final_lines(Simulation sim)
    string[] lines := []
    for: core < sim.config.cores
        lines = lines.concat(cache_rows("c{core}", sim.l1[core], sim.config.line_size))
        counts := stats.Counters()
        for row := sim.l1[core].entries[]
            for line := row[]
                if line.block >= 0
                    stats.add(&counts, "lines")
                    stats.add(&counts, line.state)
        lines = lines.append("c{core} " + stats.values(counts, ["lines", "M", "O", "E", "S", "V"]))
    lines = lines.concat(cache_rows("L2", sim.l2, sim.config.line_size))
    counts := stats.Counters()
    for row := sim.l2.entries[]
        for line := row[]
            if line.block < 0
                continue
            stats.add(&counts, "lines")
            stats.add(&counts, if line.state == "D" then "dirty" else "clean")
            in_l1 := false
            for l1 := sim.l1[]
                if cache.state(l1, line.block) != "I"
                    in_l1 = true
            if in_l1
                stats.add(&counts, "in_l1")
    lines = lines.append("L2 " + stats.values(counts, ["lines", "dirty", "clean", "in_l1"]))
    return lines

string[] report(config_io.Config config, Trace trace, Reuse[] analyses, Simulation[] simulations, int primary)
    l1_sets := config.l1_size / (config.line_size * config.l1_ways)
    l2_sets := config.l2_size / (config.line_size * config.l2_ways)
    lines := ["trace lines {trace.line_count} accepted {#trace.events} rejected {#trace.rejected}"]
    lines = lines.concat(trace.rejected)
    lines = lines.append("geometry cores {config.cores} line {config.line_size} l1 {config.l1_size} {config.l1_ways} sets {l1_sets} l2 {config.l2_size} {config.l2_ways} sets {l2_sets}")
    lines = lines.append("latency l1 {config.t1} l2 {config.t2} memory {config.tm} bus {config.tb}")
    lines = lines.append("").concat(reuse_lines(analyses))
    for simulation := simulations[]
        lines = lines.append("").concat(scenario_lines(simulation))
    lines = lines.append("").append("ranking")
    order := [for i := (0:<(int(#simulations)))[] then i]
    finishes := [for sim := simulations[] then stats.total(sim.cores).finish]
    transactions := [for sim := simulations[] then int(#sim.shared_bus.transactions)]
    order = order.sorted(by = (finishes, transactions))
    for: rank < int(#order)
        simulation := simulations[order[rank]]
        total := stats.total(simulation.cores)
        latency := stats.get(total, "latency")
        accesses := stats.get(total, "accesses")
        lines = lines.append("{rank + 1} {simulation.scenario.name} finish {total.finish} transactions {#simulation.shared_bus.transactions} amat " + stats.fraction(latency, accesses) + " " + stats.decimal(latency, accesses))
    main_scenario := simulations[primary]
    lines = lines.append("").concat(hot_lines(main_scenario))
    lines = lines.append("").concat(interval_lines(main_scenario))
    lines = lines.append("").concat(slow_lines(main_scenario))
    return lines.append("").concat(region_lines(main_scenario))

void run_program()
    config := config_io.read_config()
    trace := validate(config)
    analyses := reuse_analysis(&trace.events, config)
    Simulation[] simulations := []
    primary := 0
    for scenario := config.scenarios[]
        if scenario.name == config.primary
            primary = int(#simulations)
        simulation := Simulation(config, scenario, trace.events)
        simulate(&simulation)
        simulations = simulations.append(simulation)
    main_scenario := simulations[primary]
    if not file.exists("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    config_io.write_lines("stats.txt", report(config, trace, analyses, simulations, primary))
    config_io.write_lines("bus_log.txt", [for transaction := main_scenario.shared_bus.transactions[] then bus.format_line(transaction, config.line_size)])
    config_io.write_lines("watch.txt", main_scenario.watch_lines)
    config_io.write_lines("sharing.txt", sharing_lines(main_scenario))
    config_io.write_lines("final_state.txt", final_lines(main_scenario))

run_program()

import math
class Counters()
    counts := map<string, int>()
    finish := 0

int get(Counters counters, string name)
    match counters.counts.get(name)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

void add(Counters &counters, string name, value := 1)
    .counters.counts.set(name, get(counters, name) + value)

Counters total(Counters[] cores)
    result := Counters()
    for core := cores[]
        for key := core.counts.keys()[]
            add(&result, key, get(core, key))
        result.finish = math.max(result.finish, core.finish)
    return result

string fraction(int p, int q)
    first := p
    second := q
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return "{p / first}/{q / first}"

string decimal(int p, int q)
    value := (2 * p * 100 + q) / (2 * q)
    remainder := "{value % 100}"
    if value % 100 < 10
        remainder = "0" + remainder
    return "{value / 100}." + remainder

string core_string(bool[] flags)
    result := ""
    for: core < int(#flags)
        if flags[core]
            result += "{core}"
    return if result == "" then "-" else result

string values(Counters counters, string[] names)
    return [for name := names[] then "{name} {get(counters, name)}"].join(" ")

string[] six_lines(string label, Counters counters)
    latency := get(counters, "latency")
    accesses := get(counters, "accesses")
    return [
        label + " " + values(counters, ["accesses", "reads", "writes", "hits", "misses", "fences"]),
        label + " misses " + values(counters, ["compulsory", "capacity", "conflict", "coherence", "true_sharing", "false_sharing"]),
        label + " service " + values(counters, ["l1", "upgrade", "through", "cache", "l2", "memory"]),
        label + " bus " + values(counters, ["BusRd", "BusRdX", "BusUpgr", "BusWr", "WB"]),
        label + " snoop " + values(counters, ["invalidations_sent", "invalidations_received", "supplied", "back_invalidations"]),
        label + " time latency {latency} amat " + fraction(latency, accesses) + " " + decimal(latency, accesses) + " fence_stall {get(counters, "fence_stall")} finish {counters.finish}"
    ]
